FROM OUR ATELIER TO YOU

Delivery with care.
Easy exchanges.

The practical details for receiving your order—and what to do when something is not quite right.

LAST UPDATED 12 OCTOBER 2026

STILL WONDERING?

Talk to a real person.

For an order, a fit question, or anything else, the atelier is a conversation away.

Chat on WhatsApp
More ways to reach us
01
Preparing your order

In-stock pieces are normally prepared and dispatched within 48 hours of order confirmation. We will contact you if an item needs more time or if we need to confirm any part of your order.

02
Delivery

Standard delivery across Nigeria usually takes 2–4 business days after dispatch. Same-day delivery may be available within Lagos for eligible orders confirmed before the daily cut-off. Timing can vary by destination and courier.

Standard delivery is complimentary above the order threshold displayed on the site. All other available delivery fees are shown at checkout before payment.

03
Atelier collection

Collection from our Surulere atelier may be arranged in advance. Please wait for confirmation that your order is ready before making your journey.

04
Exchanges

Contact us within 7 days of delivery to request an eligible size exchange. Items must be unworn, unwashed, unaltered and returned with all original tags and packaging. An exchange is subject to the requested replacement being in stock.

05
Returns and exceptions

Earrings are final sale for hygiene reasons unless faulty. Bespoke, altered and personalised pieces cannot be returned or exchanged. Delivery charges are not refundable unless the item supplied was faulty or incorrect.

If your order arrives damaged or does not match what you ordered, contact us promptly with your order reference and clear photographs so we can put it right.

YOUR INFORMATION

Privacy,
plainly explained.

This notice explains the information used to provide the storefront, fulfil orders and respond when you contact us.

LAST UPDATED 12 OCTOBER 2026

STILL WONDERING?

Talk to a real person.

For an order, a fit question, or anything else, the atelier is a conversation away.

Chat on WhatsApp
More ways to reach us
01
Information you share

We may receive your name, email address, phone number, delivery address, order details and any information you choose to share when you place an order, create an account or contact the atelier.

02
How it is used

We use this information to process and deliver orders, provide customer care, manage exchanges, keep necessary business records and send marketing messages only where you have chosen to receive them.

03
Storefront preferences

This site may use browser storage to remember your bag, wishlist, preferred currency and other storefront choices on your device. You can clear this data using your browser settings, although doing so may reset those choices.

04
Payments and service providers

When online payments are enabled, payment details are handled by the payment provider identified at checkout; we do not need to store your complete card details. We may also share only the information needed with delivery, hosting and other service providers that help us operate the store.

05
Your choices

You may ask what personal information we hold about you, request a correction or ask us to delete information we no longer need to keep. You can also withdraw from marketing messages at any time.

Send privacy questions to hello@wearablesatelier.com.

THE FINE PRINT

Clear terms.
Beautiful pieces.

These terms apply when you use this storefront or place an order with Wearables Atelier.

LAST UPDATED 12 OCTOBER 2026

STILL WONDERING?

Talk to a real person.

For an order, a fit question, or anything else, the atelier is a conversation away.

Chat on WhatsApp
More ways to reach us
01
Using the storefront

Please use the site lawfully and provide accurate information when ordering. Product descriptions, imagery and availability may be updated without notice. Colours can also vary slightly between screens and in different light.

02
Orders

An order is a request to purchase. It is accepted when we confirm it and, where required, receive successful payment. If a piece becomes unavailable or an obvious pricing error is found, we may cancel the affected item and arrange a refund of any amount paid for it.

03
Prices and payment

Prices are shown in the selected display currency. The checkout total includes the products and any applicable delivery charge shown before you confirm the order. Your payment provider may apply its own currency conversion or bank fees.

04
Delivery, exchanges and returns

Delivery estimates are not guaranteed and can be affected by couriers, destination or events outside our reasonable control. Eligibility for exchanges and returns is set out on our Shipping & Returns page and forms part of these terms.

05
Our work

The Wearables Atelier name, branding, site design, copy and imagery may not be copied or used commercially without permission. Product names and third-party material remain the property of their respective owners.

06
Responsibility and contact

Nothing in these terms removes rights that cannot lawfully be excluded. To the extent permitted by law, we are not responsible for indirect loss arising from use of the site. These terms are governed by the laws of the Federal Republic of Nigeria.

Contact the atelier if you have a question before placing an order.
